ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word بَالُونٌ (baaluun) mean? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. juice
   C. balloon
   D. candle

2. What is a prediction? (1 mark)
   A. A spelling test
   B. A list of words
   C. A sensible guess about what will happen next
   D. A copy of a picture

3. Which day has the letter jiim in its name? (1 mark)
   A. al-khamiis
   B. as-sabt
   C. al-jumuʿa
   D. al-ahad

4. Which sound does the Arabic letter ج make? (1 mark)
   A. a quick rolled r
   B. f as in fan
   C. j as in jug
   D. s as in sun

5. How do you read the syllable قَا? (1 mark)
   A. nu
   B. qaa
   C. ba
   D. da

6. How is the Arabic word أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. aghmiD ʿaynayka
   B. aghliqi l-baab
   C. uktub
   D. ukhruj

7. What does the Arabic word عِيدٌ (ʿiid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. no
   B. festival
   C. friend
   D. song

8. How is the Arabic word سَمَكٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. bayd
   B. samak
   C. maa'
   D. milh

9. Which sentence is a good ending for a paragraph about your room? (1 mark)
   A. uhibbu ghurfatii
   B. fii l-ghurfati sariir
   C. haadhihi ghurfatii
   D. al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila

10. What is the name of the Arabic letter ط? (1 mark)
   A. waaw
   B. Taa
   C. alif
   D. Haa

11. Which Arabic word means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدَّةٌ
   B. أُخْتٌ
   C. أَبٌ
   D. عَمَّةٌ

12. What does the Arabic word لِسَانٌ (lisaan) mean? (1 mark)
   A. tongue
   B. body
   C. ear
   D. finger

13. Which Arabic word means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   B. غَدًا
   C. الِاثْنَيْنِ
   D. الْيَوْمَ

14. How is the Arabic word رَقَبَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. wajh
   B. yad
   C. isbaʿ
   D. raqaba

15. How does the Arabic comma ، differ from the English comma? (1 mark)
   A. It is a line
   B. It is reversed
   C. It is a dot
   D. It is bigger

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: al-maa'u mufiid (2 marks)

17. List four characteristics of good handwriting. (4 marks) (4 marks)

18. Translate into English: haadhaa matar (2 marks)

19. Write five parts of the body in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

20. Look at a picture of a birthday party with a cake with a candle and friends standing round the table. Make a prediction and give a reason. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — balloon
   بَالُونٌ (baaluun) means balloon.

2. C — A sensible guess about what will happen next
   We use clues to predict what may happen next.

3. C — al-jumuʿa
   الجمعة contains jiim (ج).

4. C — j as in jug
   The letter ج makes the sound j as in jug.

5. B — qaa
   قَا is read qaa.

6. B — aghliqi l-baab
   أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ is read aghliqi l-baab and means close the door.

7. B — festival
   عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

8. B — samak
   سَمَكٌ is read samak and means fish.

9. A — uhibbu ghurfatii
   uhibbu ghurfatii (I like my room) gives a closing feeling.

10. B — Taa
   The letter ط is called Taa.

11. C — أَبٌ
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

12. A — tongue
   لِسَانٌ (lisaan) means tongue.

13. C — الِاثْنَيْنِ
   الِاثْنَيْنِ (al-ithnayn) means Monday.

14. D — raqaba
   رَقَبَةٌ is read raqaba and means neck.

15. B — It is reversed
   The Arabic comma and question mark are reversed because the script goes right to left.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water is useful (good for you).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Correct letter shapes; letters the same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; even spacing; clean page.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid characteristic, up to 4.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), wajh (face), shaʿr (hair), ʿayn (eye), udhun (ear).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends will sing and eat the cake, because the cake has a candle and they stand round the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible prediction and 1 mark for a reason from the picture.
